FluxManga BSDIFF40 adaptation (2026-10-24)

Reference: FreeBSD src 725a9f47324d42037db93c27ceb40d4956872f3e
usr.bin/bsdiff/bspatch/bspatch.c and usr.bin/bsdiff/bsdiff/bsdiff.c
Copyright 2003-2005 Colin Percival. BSD-2-Clause; see bsdiff-LICENSE.txt.

BsdiffPatch.kt adapts the BSDIFF40 layout, sign-magnitude offsets and
control/diff/extra application to Kotlin, retaining old-file overlap behavior.
Changes: bounded section streams, random-access read-only base APK, fixed-size
output buffers, coroutine checkpoints, signed target length, exact arithmetic,
independent output file, and final hash/package/signature checks in the caller.
No FreeBSD executable, native libbzip2 or entire upstream application is bundled.

BZip2 decompression uses Apache Commons Compress 1.28.0 with its declared
Commons IO 2.20.0, Commons Lang 3.18.0 and Commons Codec 1.19.0 dependencies.
Original Apache LICENSE and NOTICE documents are retained beside this file.
This source-level dependency addition has not been built or measured.

The release helper invokes a separately supplied BSDIFF40 generator and records
its SHA-256; a format/header check does not prove that executable was compiled
from the reference commit. The release operator supplies the trusted tool.
Neither bsdiff4 nor jbsdiff is a project runtime or release-helper dependency.
